_comment: 야담 채널 고정 그림체. 2026-07-26 사용자 확정 — 연이/소하 턴어라운드를 만든 프리셋으로 복귀. 실사 방향(semi-realistic digital painting/realistic anatomy)으로 밀었더니 얼굴이 평범해져서 되돌림. 미형 여부는 여기가 아니라 characters.json의 인물 lock에 넣는다(SKILL+.md §15-5).
preset: Korean folktale illustration, semi-realistic Korean webtoon (manhwa) style, warm muted palette, beautiful idealized faces with natural human proportions, finely detailed soft skin shading with subtle blush on cheeks and nose, large glossy eyes with crisp catchlights and moist tear-film highlights, delicate individual hair strands with loose stray wisps, fine thin lineart, smooth luminous shading, cinematic widescreen 16:9, highly detailed, high quality. Set in the Joseon dynasty of old Korea; ALL people are Korean wearing traditional hanbok; Korean thatched-roof hanok houses, period-accurate Korean village; NOT Western, NOT European, NOT Japanese, NOT fantasy.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Not flat cel shading, not chibi, not a 3D CGI render.
_comment_nocast: ★2026-08-02 산가지 실측 — cast가 빈 씬(무인 풍경·군중 원경·소품 클로즈업)에는 인물 시트가 한 장도 안 붙는데, scene_preset의 절반 이상이 얼굴 렌더링 지시라 모델이 '없는 얼굴'을 만들어 넣고 앵커가 없어 사진풍으로 그렸다(19씬 중 7씬 파손). build.py가 char_refs==0일 때 아래 두 필드로 갈아끼운다. 얼굴 렌더링 블록과 'shallow depth of field...behind the subject'를 뺐고(원경에서 배경이 뭉개지는 원인), 대신 '큰 얼굴 금지'를 negative에 넣었다. 배경 인물 자체는 허용 — 금지 대상은 프레임에 끼어드는 초상화급 얼굴이다.

scene_negative_nocast: NO LARGE FACE ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE. Do not insert a close-up face, a portrait, or a person's head filling any part of the frame. No face in the foreground, no face at the edge of frame, no face overlaid on the scenery, no repeated faces. Every person, if any, is small and distant. Not photorealistic, not a photograph, no photographic skin texture or pores. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no Hangul, no legible glyphs, no signage text. No glowing white outline, no halo, no lens flare or bloom. Not desaturated, not washed out, not hazy. Not flat cel shading, no thick uniform outlines, not chibi, not a 3D CGI render. The artwork must fill the entire frame edge to edge — no white margin, no border, no frame or matte around the picture, not a framed illustration on a white background. The image must be FULL BLEED: no black bars, no white bars, no horizontal letterbox band across the top or bottom, no vertical pillarbox band at the sides — the artwork reaches all four edges.
scene_preset: Korean folktale illustration, semi-realistic Korean webtoon (manhwa) digital painting, beautiful idealized faces with natural human proportions. The light in the scene MODELS the face: a cast shadow beside the bridge of the nose, volume on the cheekbones, shading under the jaw and lower lip, a readable terminator where the lit side meets the shadow side. Eyes rendered wet and glossy — the iris shows ring texture and radial fibers, the pupil deep, two or three specular catchlights of different sizes on each eyeball, tear-film glint along the lower lash line, individually separated long lashes. A gentle sheen on the glossy black hair where the light falls, darker between the strands, loose stray wisps framing the face. Skin rendered in continuous painterly gradients with subsurface glow and a natural blush on cheeks and nose. Fine thin lineart of varying weight, thicker on the shadow side, thinning to nothing in the light. Clear separation between light and shadow with clean deep darks and rich color, shallow depth of field with the background softly blurred behind the subject. FULL-BLEED widescreen 16:9 composition in which the artwork reaches all four edges of the canvas, highly detailed, high quality. Set in the Joseon dynasty of old Korea; ALL people are Korean wearing traditional hanbok; Korean thatched-roof hanok houses, period-accurate Korean village; NOT Western, NOT European, NOT Japanese, NOT fantasy.
scene_negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. No glowing white outline around the figure, no halo or aura, no backlit silhouette glow, no over-bright edge lighting, no lens flare or bloom. No flat even lighting, no washed-out low-contrast image, not desaturated, not pastel-faded, not milky, not hazy. Eyes must not be solid black blobs without iris detail. Not flat cel shading with hard two-tone shadow blocks, no thick uniform outlines, no simplified cartoon faces, not chibi, not a 3D CGI render, not a mobile-webtoon-app flat art style. The artwork must fill the entire frame edge to edge — no white margin, no border, no frame or matte around the picture, not a framed illustration placed on a white background, no letterboxing, no black bars. No Hangul and no modern Korean alphabet anywhere in the image, no legible glyphs, no readable calligraphy, no signage text, no subtitles burned into the picture. The image must be FULL BLEED: no black bars, no white bars, no horizontal letterbox band across the top or bottom, no vertical pillarbox band at the sides — the artwork reaches all four edges.
_comment_scene: 씬 이미지 전용(build.py만 읽음, turnaround/background는 preset 사용). 2026-07-26 _soha_scene_v2로 확정. ★조명 방향·시간대는 여기 넣지 말 것 — chiaroscuro/deep falloff/film-still grading을 넣었더니 모든 씬이 밤으로 끌려갔다(v3/v5 실측). 시간대·광원은 씬별 visual_desc가 정한다. ★후광 금지 문구 필수 — 'silver-white edge tracing the crown'류가 실루엣에 흰 테두리를 둘러 후광처럼 보인다. ★2026-08-02 이름석자 30씬 실측: 문서 클로즈업에서 **현대 한글이 그대로 렌더링**됐고(조선 문서 고증 파괴), 30씬 중 6장에 상하 레터박스 띠가 생겼다. scene_negative에 '한글·가독 글자 금지'와 'full bleed(레터박스 금지)'를 명시적으로 추가. 단 근본 해결은 씬 visual_desc에 'all writing must be ILLEGIBLE' 지시를 넣는 것이다 — visual_desc가 'brushed characters'를 요구하면 negative만으로는 못 막는다.
_watch_scene: ⚠️ 첫 배치에서 확인할 것 — scene_preset 끝의 'shallow depth of field with the background softly blurred behind the subject'는 확정 근거가 클로즈업 인물 컷이라 들어간 문구다. 원경·establishing 씬(무인 마당, 마을 전경)에서 배경이 뭉개지면 이 한 구절만 빼고 재생성. 나머지는 건드리지 말 것. ★2026-07-28 추가: full-bleed 금지구(흰 여백/액자 테두리) — 96씬 중 2장이 흰 배경 위 액자 그림으로 나와 그대로는 못 썼다.
